page_title: FinchGram — A Telegram client with superpowers

sources.entry: FinchGram - Unofficial open-source Telegram client built on TDLib, with a screenshot tool, WebDAV downloads and opt-in MCP access for AI assistants. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/FinchGram/FinchGram) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: FinchGram
summary.one_liner: FinchGram is an unofficial, open-source Telegram client for macOS on Apple silicon, built on TDLib, with tabbed chats, a built-in screenshot tool, WebDAV/NAS downloads and opt-in MCP access for AI assistants.
use_cases: chat on Telegram from a Mac with a keyboard-focused interface
download files from a NAS or seedbox into Telegram
capture, annotate and send screenshots in Telegram
let an AI assistant read or draft Telegram messages with opt-in controls
run multiple Telegram chats in tabs
summary.what_it_does: FinchGram is a Telegram client that shows chats with folders, pinned chats, unread counts and mentions, with search via ⌘K and ⌘F. It supports messages, replies, forwards, media, stickers and a media viewer, where video plays through mpv. A screenshot tool on ⌘⇧A lets users capture a window or selection, mark it up with shapes, text and mosaic, and send, copy or save it. It can browse WebDAV servers and download files in 8 MB chunks over up to twelve connections, resuming interrupted transfers. It also works as an MCP server so apps like Claude Desktop or Cursor can access chats, but only when the user enables it in Settings.
notable: Built on TDLib with the source public under GPL-3.0
Opt-in MCP server so AI assistants can access chats, with per-chat and write-permission controls
WebDAV browser with chunked, resumable downloads and read-only server access
Screenshot tool with annotation and send-to-chat
caveats: Currently macOS 12+ on Apple silicon only; Windows and Linux are later, iOS and Android are later still
Unofficial client, not made by Telegram
Secret chats, voice messages, polls, scheduled messages and calls are not yet available (calls and multiple accounts are listed as later)
